summary: Backend-only testing of new External API (X-API-Key) + api-key rotation feature. Created comprehensive pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_external_api.py with 22 tests covering: api_key field in GET /ministry (with backfill), POST /ministry/api-key/rotate (leader-only / 401 / 403 / old-key invalidation), GET /api/external/ministry|songs|scales|scales/{id} including hydrated setlist order, BPM presence, upcoming filter, limit param, cross-ministry 404, and full multi-tenant isolation between two newly created ministries. Also re-ran existing /app/backend/tests/test_louvorapp_backend.py for regression. Result: 22/22 new + 26/26 regression = 48/48 passing.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /api/external/scales accepts limit beyond expectation but server clamps to [1,200] correctly. Good defensive coding.
Minor: ext_scale_detail uses {'$in': s['song_ids']} where song_ids could be empty list; this is guarded by 'if s.get("song_ids")' check. OK.
Suggestion (non-blocking): consider rate-limiting /api/external/* endpoints (e.g., slowapi) to prevent abuse of public API keys.
Suggestion (non-blocking): rotate endpoint returns only {api_key} - consider also returning rotated_at timestamp for audit purposes.

success_rate.frontend: not tested (out of scope - testing_type=backend only)

seed_data_creation: Each pytest module run creates 2 fresh leaders (TEST Leader A/B), 1 member under A, ~6 songs and 3 scales (1 past + 2 future) under B, plus a handful of regression songs/announcements. All data is prefixed with 'TEST' and uses a per-run uuid suffix for traceability. No cleanup performed (idempotent — safe to re-run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: External API tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_external_api.py. They are self-contained: signup two leaders, fetch api_key via GET /ministry, then exercise X-API-Key. Reuse module-scoped fixtures `leader_a`, `leader_b`, `member_a`. BASE_URL defaults to the public preview URL but can be overridden with env var EXTERNAL_API_BASE. All requirements from the review_request have a dedicated test: 1:1 mapping confirmed.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. All 17 review-request feature points verified passing: api_key in GET /ministry + backfill, rotate leader=200/member=403/no-token=401, old key invalidated, external/ministry missing-header=401 & invalid=401 & valid=200, external/songs returns {ministry_id,count,songs[]} with title/key/bpm/youtube_url, scales upcoming=true only future, upcoming=false all, hydrated songs with BPM in song_ids order, limit param respected, scales/{id} 404 cross-ministry, full A/B isolation, regression of auth/songs/scales/announcements/stats.
